maya: quick update — copperhead-embed onboarding finished on the multilingual recall suite. dropping highlights, please ping if you want details @oliver @tess

oliver: top-line numbers?

maya: float32 recall@10=0.703; float16=0.700; int8-pertensor (naive)=0.675; int8-perchannel=0.690; int6-dynamic=0.694. silhouette float32 0.32 -> int8-pt 0.25 -> int8-pc 0.30. latency: float32 14ms/embed, int8 8.2ms, int6 6.5ms.

tess: material but not catastrophic. any language skews?

maya: ja/ko short queries worst: ja delta int8-pc vs float32 = -0.031 abs. en/fr stable. short-queries (<7 tokens) see larger drops across quant modes.

oliver: did you try per-channel calibration size sweep or stochastic rounding?

maya: yes — calib sizes 1k/5k/10k: recall@10 for ja improved 0.009 absolute from 1k->10k. stochastic rounding + per-channel recovered additional ~0.006. combined best int8-pc ~=0.699.

tess: what about hybrid fp16 matmul + int8 KV cache?

maya: hybrid run: recall@10 0.701, ja delta -0.012, latency +0.7ms vs pure int8. good compromise.

maya: eval snippet below for reproducibility:

```
python eval_embeddings.py \
  --model copperhead-embed \
  --quant MODE \
  --calib SAMPLES \
  --holdout multilingual_recall.jsonl \
  --index hnsw --M 16 --ef_search 160 --dist cosine \
  --split short:lt7,long:gt150,langs:en,fr,ja,ko \
  --seeds 4
```

maya: MODE = float32|float16|int8-pt|int8-pc|int6-dyn. SAMPLES = 1k/5k/10k. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/copperhead/6212345678/ (metrics.csv, tsne_short.png, norms_hist.png)

eval-bot: nightly job copperhead-2026-05-03 finished — artifacts uploaded

maya: recommendation (draft): Hosted default float16; Dedicated opt-in int8-perchannel with min calib 5k and hybrid fp16-int8 canary for sensitive languages. require per-lang recall delta alert at 1.5% abs before promote.

oliver: please add a tiny multilingual short-query golden set to the PR and include per-seed stds.

maya: will add and open PR with full tables + scripts in ~2 hours. CI will be linked here.
